description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements a logging node that wraps Android's native Log utility, allowing log messages to be piped through a chain of LogNode objects. It provides methods to set the next node and to print log entries, optionally including exceptions.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native Log utility and implements the LogNode interface to facilitate chained logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to send log data to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message with the specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable. Passes the log to the next node if available.
